scenarios.scenario_abstract: While building a technical school's prom identity, [X] chooses how classic ceremony, modern geometric precision, a vehicle-like mascot, five different trades, and a historical engineer-patron should coexist without becoming a collage. A later turn tests the chosen direction on another event format and confirms or corrects its visual language.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在为技术学校建立舞会视觉身份时，[X]需要决定如何让经典仪式感、现代几何精度、车辆式吉祥物、五个不同专业和历史工程师校祖共存而不变成拼贴；后续回合会把选定方向应用到另一种活动载体上，再确认或修正其视觉语言。
scenarios.multi_turn_confirmation: A visual direction is first selected for the core mark; a later turn applies it to a ticket, invitation, or large backdrop and confirms whether the mascot, patron reference, and five departments still read as one identity.

scenarios.scenario_abstract: While comparing a first-class ocean-liner crossing with several luxury trains, [X] weighs spacious classic glamour, compact Art Deco cabins, warm heritage interiors, and serene modern restraint. A later turn uses suite layouts or photographs to confirm whether the favored atmosphere survives contact with the real space.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在比较头等远洋航线与多种豪华列车时，[X]权衡宽敞的经典华丽感、紧凑的装饰艺术车厢、温暖的传承式内饰和宁静的现代克制；后续回合会借助套房平面或照片，确认偏爱的氛围在真实空间中是否仍然成立。
scenarios.multi_turn_confirmation: One refined atmosphere is first favored from descriptions; a later turn compares actual suite layouts or photographs and confirms whether the same style still feels desirable when spatial scale and detail become visible.

scenarios.scenario_abstract: For a solo coastal-history trip without a car, [X] chooses an affordable old guesthouse for its romantic architecture, antique interior, fireplaces, and walkable surroundings rather than for star rating alone. A later turn checks a real room or nearby cafe view and confirms whether the historic atmosphere remains personally appealing.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在一次无需驾车的独自海滨历史旅行中，[X]选择价格可承受的老旅馆，是看中其浪漫建筑、古董内饰、壁炉和可步行的周边，而不是只看星级；后续回合会查看真实客房或附近咖啡馆的画面，确认这种历史氛围是否仍符合个人喜好。
scenarios.multi_turn_confirmation: The historic stay is first chosen from descriptions; a later turn reviews a real room, nearby street, or cafe image and confirms whether the old-world atmosphere feels inviting rather than merely dated.

scenarios.scenario_abstract: While hand-carving fine cursive into several walnut boards, [X] preserves natural grain and visible making marks but chooses clean modern frames for display. A later turn views the completed series together and confirms whether the presentation balances workshop character with restrained structure.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在若干胡桃木板上手工雕刻细线连笔字时，[X]保留天然木纹和可见的制作痕迹，同时为陈列选择线条干净的现代框架；后续回合会把整组作品并排查看，确认呈现方式能否在工坊气质与克制结构之间取得平衡。
scenarios.multi_turn_confirmation: A clean display direction is first chosen for one carved board; a later turn hangs several boards together and confirms whether the frames preserve the handmade character without making the wall visually busy.

scenarios.scenario_abstract: During a deliberately slow Japan trip, [X] explores fashion districts, vintage stores, cute character spaces, games, sweets, and an indie performance without compressing them into a checklist. A later turn compares discoveries from two different stops and confirms which visual direction repeatedly feels personally appealing.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在一段刻意放慢节奏的日本旅行中，[X]从容浏览时尚街区、古着店、可爱角色空间、游戏、甜品和独立演出，不把它们压缩成打卡清单；后续回合会比较两个不同地点的发现，确认哪种视觉方向反复产生个人吸引力。
scenarios.multi_turn_confirmation: A visual direction is first noticed in one district or event; a later turn compares finds from another fashion area or character venue and confirms whether that direction is a recurring personal preference rather than a one-stop novelty.

scenarios.scenario_abstract: While hosting an outdoor luncheon for a large group of longtime golf friends, [X] selects a shared dress theme that feels original but still works for lawn activities, sun, weather, and adult social comfort. A later turn compares several guests' interpretations and confirms whether the group still reads as intentionally coordinated.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在为一大群多年高尔夫球友举办户外午宴时，[X]选择既有新意、又能适应草地活动、日晒、天气和成人社交舒适度的共同着装主题；后续回合会比较几位来宾的具体演绎，确认整组人是否仍呈现出有意识的协调感。
scenarios.multi_turn_confirmation: The group first chooses a dress direction; a later turn reviews several guests' proposed interpretations or a weather update and confirms whether the theme remains recognizable, comfortable, and practical outdoors.

scenarios.scenario_abstract: For a restorative trip centered on a pool, nature, and good food, [X] compares a barefoot natural retreat with a more polished or minimal lodge instead of planning many attractions. A later turn reviews the actual property and confirms whether the chosen atmosphere would still make it easy to slow down.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在以泳池、自然和美食为核心的恢复性旅行中，[X]比较赤足自然的休憩地与更精致或极简的旅宿，而不是堆叠许多景点；后续回合会查看真实住宿环境，确认选定氛围是否确实有助于放慢节奏。
scenarios.multi_turn_confirmation: A retreat atmosphere is first selected from a small set of concrete options; a later turn inspects the actual room, pool, dining, or landscape images and confirms whether the chosen degree of rustic ease or polished restraint still supports rest.

scenarios.scenario_abstract: While redecorating a medium bedroom on a fixed online-shopping budget, [X] applies a minimal Scandinavian direction across bedding, lighting, rug, wall treatment, curtains, plants, and storage. A later turn views the partly assembled room and confirms whether it remains warm and intentional without becoming cluttered or sterile.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在固定网购预算内改造一间中等大小的卧室时，[X]把极简北欧方向贯穿到床品、照明、地毯、墙面、窗帘、植物和收纳中；后续回合会查看阶段性成品，确认空间是否温暖而有整体感，同时没有变得杂乱或冷冰冰。
scenarios.multi_turn_confirmation: The direction is first used to select one high-impact anchor; a later turn adds another large element or reviews the partly staged room and confirms whether it stays warm and intentional without accumulating visual clutter.

scenarios.scenario_abstract: While replacing an owned classic road bike, [X] compares an understated British performance machine with a more theatrical Italian alternative for both occasional track use and a thirty-minute commute. A later turn uses test-ride or commute feedback to confirm whether the favored identity still fits everyday ownership.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在更换已有的经典街车时，[X]比较克制的英式性能机器与更具戏剧性的意式方案，同时考虑偶尔下赛道和单程三十分钟通勤；后续回合会依据试骑或通勤反馈，确认偏爱的身份表达是否仍适合日常拥有。
scenarios.multi_turn_confirmation: A performance identity is first favored on specifications and appearance; a later turn follows a test ride or commute simulation and confirms whether the same direction still feels personally right under daily heat, comfort, parking, and maintenance constraints.

scenarios.scenario_abstract: While producing black-and-white assets for a 2D game, [X] rejects painterly, paper-textured results and pivots the art direction away from its earlier references toward Western noir and 1930s rubber-hose cartoon ink. A later turn checks the assets in the playable prototype and confirms that the new period language is coherent and the rejected motifs have not returned.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在为二维游戏制作黑白素材时，[X]拒绝绘画感过强、带纸张纹理的结果，并把美术方向从早期参考转向西部黑色电影与二十世纪三十年代橡皮管动画墨线；后续回合会在可玩原型中检查素材，确认新的年代语言保持统一，且被排除的母题没有重新出现。
scenarios.multi_turn_confirmation: The revised direction is first applied to one sprite or tile sheet; a later turn inspects the in-game prototype and confirms that the Western period cues remain coherent and that rejected motifs or textures have not returned.

professional_scenarios.scenario_abstract: A fashion founder carries a first garment through patterning, fitting, sample production, and a small commercial batch, then requires the name, moodboard, photography, packaging, storefront, and advertising to express the same chosen identity. Later launch materials are reviewed against the original direction rather than allowed to drift into a different style.
professional_scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 一名时装品牌创办者把首件服装推进到制版、试穿、样衣和小批量商业生产，随后要求名称、情绪板、摄影、包装、店面和广告共同表达同一套既定身份；后续发布素材仍需回到最初方向复核，不能在不同环节各自偏成另一种风格。
professional_scenarios.multi_turn_confirmation: The identity is first applied to the garment and moodboard; later launch assets and the storefront are checked for the same direction and corrected when they drift.

professional_scenarios.scenario_abstract: A concert organizer promoting a free two-band punk show rejects polished, paragraph-heavy event copy and requests a shorter, rawer voice. A later revision is checked again for generic hashtags and marketing phrasing so the announcement remains recognizably part of the scene before it is published.
professional_scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 一名为两支乐队的免费朋克演出做宣传的主办者，拒绝过度精饰、段落繁多的活动文案，并要求改成更短、更粗粝的语气；发布前还会再次检查通用话题标签和营销措辞，确保公告仍像圈内表达。
professional_scenarios.multi_turn_confirmation: A first announcement is rejected as too polished; a later revision is checked again for length, rawness, and generic promotional markers before release.
